name: velum-scene-lab
description: Pick surprising sensual adult photography scenarios from the owner's Velum catalog and collect explicit image ratings for future creative experiments.

interface.longDescription: A private creative experiment for Velum. Selects diverse adult photographic scenarios from an owner-scoped PTI Firestore catalog using server-side randomness and recent-repeat suppression, generates an image when requested, asks for a 1–5 image rating, and saves the owner's explicit feedback against the selected prompt version. Source reference photos remain in their original storage; the plugin never copies or uploads private media to Firestore.
defaultPrompt: Surprise me with a Velum scene and generate an image using my references.
Pick a random Velum prompt without generating an image.
Show my recent Velum prompt ratings.
